name: Glaive
description: A glaive, 2.1 m from butt to point (the long class of polearms, 2 m and more): an ash shaft with an iron butt cap and two leather wraps, iron langets up to a socket, and a long single-edged blade widening to a swept-back point, with a small back hook. It stands on its butt as held, shaft along +z and edge to +x.
